model.title: Grounded Growth Lever and Archetype Model
model.purpose: Create a measurable middle layer between broad life domains, specific competencies/tasks, and human archetype presentation.

source_curriculum.title: The Ideal Person Curriculum - Pluralist Full-Scope Revision

design_decisions: Use 37 trainable developmental levers rather than the 27 broad curriculum domains as direct scores.
Use six non-evaluative orientation modes to describe style.
Generate 15 archetypes as every unordered pair of the six orientation modes.
Keep orientation, archetype, mastery, applicability, importance, readiness, urgency, access, and evidence confidence distinct.
Map every master competency to one or more levers with weights summing to 1.0.
Let concrete tasks inherit their parent competency mapping by default, with intentional overrides when the exercise trains only a subset.

lever_families.name: Orientation and Moral Center
lever_families.definition: The goods, commitments, virtues, sacred concerns, and responses to suffering that orient a life.

lever_families.name: Inner Governance
lever_families.definition: The capacities used to understand and regulate identity, emotion, attention, desire, behavior, and adaptation.

lever_families.name: Thought, Learning, and Imagination
lever_families.definition: The capacities used to reason, establish truth, make judgments, learn, teach, create, and interpret culture.

lever_families.name: Embodied and Practical Agency
lever_families.definition: The capacities needed to inhabit a body, maintain a life, use technology, manage risk, and steward material resources.

lever_families.name: Relationship and Care
lever_families.definition: The capacities needed to communicate, understand others, preserve boundaries, belong, love, care, and repair.

lever_families.name: Contribution, Society, and Power
lever_families.definition: The capacities used to contribute through service, justice, work, leadership, and responsible participation in institutions.

lever_families.name: Integration and Flourishing
lever_families.definition: The capacities used to rest, explore, balance life across seasons, and transmit value beyond the self.

developmental_levers.name: Purpose and Direction
developmental_levers.definition: Clarifies what is worth pursuing, why it matters, and how present commitments express a coherent direction.

developmental_levers.name: Values, Integrity, and Moral Courage
developmental_levers.definition: Translates ethical commitments into truthful, reliable, fair, and courageous conduct across contexts.

developmental_levers.name: Spirituality, Reverence, and Transcendence
developmental_levers.definition: Develops relationship to the sacred, ultimate concern, ritual, contemplation, vocation, and realities larger than the isolated self.

developmental_levers.name: Mortality, Suffering, Gratitude, and Hope
developmental_levers.definition: Builds the capacity to face impermanence, tragedy, loss, limitation, received life, and hope without denial.

developmental_levers.name: Self-Knowledge, Identity, and Humility
developmental_levers.definition: Improves accurate self-understanding, identity coherence, awareness of limitations and defenses, and proportionate self-regard.

developmental_levers.name: Emotional Awareness and Literacy
developmental_levers.definition: Recognizes, differentiates, names, and communicates emotions and their bodily and situational signals.

developmental_levers.name: Emotional Regulation and Resilience
developmental_levers.definition: Regulates emotion without suppression, recovers from setbacks, seeks help appropriately, and generalizes coping skills under stress.

developmental_levers.name: Attention and Presence
developmental_levers.definition: Directs attention deliberately, sustains contact with the present, and notices distraction, interpretation, and automaticity.

developmental_levers.name: Temperance and Desire Governance
developmental_levers.definition: Uses pleasure, consumption, craving, status, comfort, and impulse without being ruled by them.

developmental_levers.name: Discipline, Habits, and Follow-Through
developmental_levers.definition: Converts intentions into consistent action through habits, planning, accountability, perseverance, and completion.

developmental_levers.name: Adaptability, Uncertainty, and Learning from Failure
developmental_levers.definition: Acts under uncertainty, revises plans, tolerates change, and converts setbacks or disconfirmation into improved behavior.

developmental_levers.name: Critical Reasoning and Logic
developmental_levers.definition: Analyzes claims, arguments, assumptions, contradictions, and alternatives with disciplined reasoning.

developmental_levers.name: Evidence, Truth, and Epistemic Humility
developmental_levers.definition: Evaluates sources and evidence, tracks uncertainty, updates beliefs, and resists bias, misinformation, and overconfidence.

developmental_levers.name: Systems Thinking, Judgment, and Decision-Making
developmental_levers.definition: Understands causality, tradeoffs, risk, feedback, context, and second-order effects to make and revise sound decisions.

developmental_levers.name: Learning Agility, Memory, and Teaching
developmental_levers.definition: Acquires, organizes, practices, retains, transfers, explains, and transmits knowledge and skill.

developmental_levers.name: Creativity, Aesthetics, and Cultural Literacy
developmental_levers.definition: Creates, interprets, refines, and shares meaningful work while developing imagination, taste, cultural context, and attribution ethics.

developmental_levers.name: Physical Health, Vitality, and Embodiment
developmental_levers.definition: Maintains health, movement capacity, recovery, body literacy, bodily autonomy, and sustainable physical functioning.

developmental_levers.name: Domestic Competence and Material Self-Sufficiency
developmental_levers.definition: Operates and maintains a safe, functional home and everyday material life through practical skills and systems.

developmental_levers.name: Digital Agency, Media Literacy, and Security
developmental_levers.definition: Uses digital tools and AI competently while governing attention, verifying information, protecting identity and data, and participating responsibly online.

developmental_levers.name: Safety, Risk, and Preparedness
developmental_levers.definition: Anticipates hazards, prevents avoidable harm, responds to emergencies, and builds personal and communal resilience.

developmental_levers.name: Financial Stewardship and Provision
developmental_levers.definition: Manages cash flow, debt, saving, investing, protection, consumption, generosity, and material obligations responsibly.

developmental_levers.name: Economic Agency, Entrepreneurship, and Market Literacy
developmental_levers.definition: Understands economic systems and creates, prices, negotiates, operates, and governs value-producing activity responsibly.

developmental_levers.name: Communication and Listening
developmental_levers.definition: Listens attentively and expresses ideas, needs, feedback, stories, and arguments clearly across audiences and contexts.

developmental_levers.name: Empathy, Social Perception, and Perspective-Taking
developmental_levers.definition: Accurately perceives others' experiences, motives, emotions, needs, contexts, and viewpoints without erasing difference.

developmental_levers.name: Boundaries, Assertiveness, and Self-Respect
developmental_levers.definition: States needs and limits, protects autonomy and dignity, resists coercion, and says no or exits responsibly.

developmental_levers.name: Friendship, Belonging, and Hospitality
developmental_levers.definition: Initiates, selects, maintains, and contributes to reciprocal friendships, networks, communities, and inclusive belonging.

developmental_levers.name: Intimacy, Sexuality, and Partnership
developmental_levers.definition: Builds consensual, secure, communicative, mutually responsible intimate relationships across changing stages and forms.

developmental_levers.name: Family, Parenting, and Caregiving
developmental_levers.definition: Participates responsibly in family systems, parenting, reproduction, elder care, disability care, safeguarding, and shared household care.

developmental_levers.name: Conflict, Repair, Forgiveness, and Reconciliation
developmental_levers.definition: Navigates disagreement, de-escalates harm, apologizes, repairs trust, forgives wisely, and supports reconciliation where possible.

developmental_levers.name: Service, Citizenship, and Civic Agency
developmental_levers.definition: Contributes to community needs, understands civic channels, organizes responsibly, and builds collective capacity.

developmental_levers.name: Justice, Pluralism, and Social Responsibility
developmental_levers.definition: Understands rights, inequality, institutions, power, difference, and shared risk while preserving dignity and peaceful coexistence.

developmental_levers.name: Work, Craft, Professionalism, and Contribution
developmental_levers.definition: Builds reliable, adaptive, ethical competence and delivers useful, high-quality work with appropriate boundaries.

developmental_levers.name: Leadership, Power, Mentorship, and Institutions
developmental_levers.definition: Sets direction, uses power ethically, develops others, designs accountable institutions, and responds to conflict, crisis, corruption, and abuse.

developmental_levers.name: Play, Rest, Celebration, and Joy
developmental_levers.definition: Cultivates non-instrumental play, restoration, delight, humor, festivity, and sustainable freedom from constant optimization.

developmental_levers.name: Nature, Exploration, and Adventure
developmental_levers.definition: Builds curiosity, place-awareness, ecological relationship, travel competence, outdoor capability, wonder, and calculated challenge.

developmental_levers.name: Life Design, Balance, and Seasonality
developmental_levers.definition: Integrates competing goods, roles, capacities, seasons, transitions, reviews, ambition, contentment, and multiple legitimate pathways.

developmental_levers.name: Legacy, Generativity, and Transmission
developmental_levers.definition: Invests in people, institutions, traditions, knowledge, works, and provisions that outlast the self without confusing legacy with status.

orientation_modes.name: Discernment
orientation_modes.definition: Preference for understanding, truth-seeking, reflection, pattern recognition, and sound judgment.
orientation_modes.high_expression: Pauses to understand, tests assumptions, seeks coherence, and differentiates signal from noise.
orientation_modes.possible_excess: Analysis, detachment, hesitation, or treating lived problems as intellectual puzzles.

orientation_modes.name: Agency
orientation_modes.definition: Preference for initiating, asserting, deciding, persisting, and producing change.
orientation_modes.high_expression: Moves toward difficulty, makes choices, takes responsibility, and creates momentum.
orientation_modes.possible_excess: Control, impatience, domination, overwork, or action without sufficient listening.

orientation_modes.name: Connection
orientation_modes.definition: Preference for empathy, belonging, cooperation, mutual understanding, and relational attunement.
orientation_modes.high_expression: Reads people, builds trust, includes others, and protects relationship quality.
orientation_modes.possible_excess: Approval-seeking, enmeshment, conflict avoidance, or sacrificing truth and self-respect.

orientation_modes.name: Stewardship
orientation_modes.definition: Preference for responsibility, reliability, maintenance, protection, provision, and long-term continuity.
orientation_modes.high_expression: Preserves what matters, anticipates consequences, fulfills duties, and builds durable structures.
orientation_modes.possible_excess: Rigidity, burden, paternalism, risk aversion, or loyalty to obsolete structures.

orientation_modes.name: Exploration
orientation_modes.definition: Preference for novelty, experimentation, creativity, discovery, and possibility.
orientation_modes.high_expression: Generates options, crosses boundaries, learns through experience, and adapts quickly.
orientation_modes.possible_excess: Scattered attention, impulsivity, unfinished work, or novelty without depth.

orientation_modes.name: Transcendence
orientation_modes.definition: Preference for meaning, virtue, reverence, service, beauty, legacy, and realities larger than the isolated self.
orientation_modes.high_expression: Connects action to purpose, conscience, sacred concern, or the common good.
orientation_modes.possible_excess: Moralism, abstraction, self-sacrifice without boundaries, or bypassing practical reality.

archetypes.name: The Strategist
archetypes.core_drive: Turn clear understanding into deliberate, effective action.
archetypes.signature: Analytical, decisive, goal-directed, and comfortable making tradeoffs.
archetypes.contribution: Creates direction, chooses priorities, and converts ambiguity into an executable path.
archetypes.shadow: Can over-control, treat people as variables, or mistake decisiveness for wisdom.
archetypes.growth_edge: Practice relational awareness, receptivity, play, and respect for goods that cannot be optimized.

archetypes.name: The Counselor
archetypes.core_drive: Understand people and situations deeply enough to help them move toward clarity and repair.
archetypes.signature: Reflective, perceptive, empathic, interpretive, and skilled at seeing motives and patterns.
archetypes.contribution: Helps others name what is happening, understand competing perspectives, and make humane choices.
archetypes.shadow: Can over-analyze, absorb others' emotions, become indirect, or substitute insight for action.
archetypes.growth_edge: Strengthen boundaries, decisive action, disciplined follow-through, and tolerance for imperfect execution.

archetypes.name: The Architect
archetypes.core_drive: Build coherent systems that remain reliable over time.
archetypes.signature: Structured, principled, precise, responsible, and attentive to dependencies and consequences.
archetypes.contribution: Designs durable processes, institutions, plans, and safeguards that others can trust.
archetypes.shadow: Can become rigid, perfectionistic, detached from lived experience, or loyal to systems after they stop serving people.
archetypes.growth_edge: Develop emotional fluency, adaptability, creative experimentation, and restorative play.

archetypes.name: The Explorer
archetypes.core_drive: Discover new ideas, patterns, possibilities, and ways of seeing.
archetypes.signature: Curious, inventive, intellectually independent, open-ended, and energized by complexity.
archetypes.contribution: Expands the map, questions stale assumptions, and connects knowledge across boundaries.
archetypes.shadow: Can chase novelty, avoid commitment, intellectualize life, or leave promising work unfinished.
archetypes.growth_edge: Build follow-through, practical stewardship, embodied routines, and durable belonging.

archetypes.name: The Seeker
archetypes.core_drive: Find truth, meaning, wisdom, and a life worthy of commitment.
archetypes.signature: Contemplative, philosophically serious, self-examining, and attentive to ultimate questions.
archetypes.contribution: Provides moral and existential orientation, challenges superficial goals, and preserves depth.
archetypes.shadow: Can retreat into abstraction, spiritualize avoidable problems, or wait for certainty before living.
archetypes.growth_edge: Translate conviction into concrete action, embodiment, practical competence, and accountable relationships.

archetypes.name: The Catalyst
archetypes.core_drive: Mobilize people toward growth, action, and shared possibility.
archetypes.signature: Energetic, persuasive, socially attuned, encouraging, and comfortable initiating change.
archetypes.contribution: Creates momentum, raises confidence, and helps groups cross the gap between intention and action.
archetypes.shadow: Can rush consent, overpromise, rescue others, or confuse intensity and popularity with progress.
archetypes.growth_edge: Slow down for evidence, boundaries, systems, and patient maintenance after the initial spark.

archetypes.name: The Builder
archetypes.core_drive: Turn responsibility into concrete capability, provision, and finished results.
archetypes.signature: Practical, persistent, accountable, productive, and comfortable carrying weight.
archetypes.contribution: Makes plans real, creates stability, solves material problems, and completes difficult work.
archetypes.shadow: Can overwork, dominate, suppress emotion, or equate human worth with usefulness and output.
archetypes.growth_edge: Cultivate emotional awareness, intimacy, rest, joy, and identities not dependent on achievement.

archetypes.name: The Trailblazer
archetypes.core_drive: Open new paths through experimentation, courage, and rapid learning.
archetypes.signature: Bold, adaptable, entrepreneurial, novelty-seeking, and willing to move before certainty.
archetypes.contribution: Breaks inertia, tests possibilities, creates opportunities, and normalizes intelligent risk.
archetypes.shadow: Can become impulsive, scattered, bored by maintenance, or leave others carrying the consequences.
archetypes.growth_edge: Build discipline, risk controls, financial stewardship, reliability, and completion habits.

archetypes.name: The Reformer
archetypes.core_drive: Act on conviction to align people and institutions with a higher standard.
archetypes.signature: Purposeful, courageous, values-led, demanding, and willing to confront complacency.
archetypes.contribution: Names moral failures, organizes meaningful change, and protects ideals from becoming empty language.
archetypes.shadow: Can become self-righteous, absolutist, punitive, chronically dissatisfied, or consumed by the cause.
archetypes.growth_edge: Practice pluralism, humility, repair, proportionality, and sustainable rhythms.

archetypes.name: The Guardian
archetypes.core_drive: Protect people, relationships, and the conditions that let them thrive.
archetypes.signature: Loyal, dependable, nurturing, attentive, and sensitive to practical and relational needs.
archetypes.contribution: Creates safety, continuity, belonging, and dependable care in families and communities.
archetypes.shadow: Can overfunction, become paternalistic, avoid necessary disruption, or neglect personal needs.
archetypes.growth_edge: Strengthen boundaries, self-direction, experimentation, and the ability to let others carry responsibility.

archetypes.name: The Connector
archetypes.core_drive: Create belonging and possibility by linking people, cultures, and experiences.
archetypes.signature: Sociable, curious, expressive, inclusive, and energized by shared discovery.
archetypes.contribution: Builds networks, translates across groups, creates hospitality, and makes life feel larger.
archetypes.shadow: Can seek approval, diffuse attention, avoid depth, or mistake activity and contact for intimacy.
archetypes.growth_edge: Develop disciplined attention, evidence standards, boundaries, and sustained commitment.

archetypes.name: The Healer
archetypes.core_drive: Relieve suffering and restore dignity, trust, wholeness, and hope.
archetypes.signature: Compassionate, patient, receptive, meaning-oriented, and attentive to vulnerability.
archetypes.contribution: Supports repair, accompanies people through loss, and keeps mercy connected to human dignity.
archetypes.shadow: Can become a martyr, blur boundaries, excuse harm, or make being needed central to identity.
archetypes.growth_edge: Pair compassion with assertion, justice, accountability, and material self-stewardship.

archetypes.name: The Craftsman
archetypes.core_drive: Improve reality through disciplined skill, experimentation, and care for quality.
archetypes.signature: Hands-on, inventive, patient with iteration, standards-conscious, and absorbed by mastery.
archetypes.contribution: Produces useful and beautiful work, preserves tacit knowledge, and raises the quality of practice.
archetypes.shadow: Can become perfectionistic, narrow, isolated, or more comfortable with objects and systems than people.
archetypes.growth_edge: Connect craft to purpose, communication, belonging, teaching, and broader social consequence.

archetypes.name: The Steward
archetypes.core_drive: Preserve and transmit what is valuable across people, institutions, resources, and generations.
archetypes.signature: Faithful, patient, duty-conscious, long-term oriented, and grounded in responsibility beyond the self.
archetypes.contribution: Maintains continuity, protects shared goods, mentors successors, and prevents short-term appetite from consuming the future.
archetypes.shadow: Can become burdened, conservative by reflex, controlling, or loyal to inherited forms that need reform.
archetypes.growth_edge: Welcome creativity, experimentation, adaptability, joy, and necessary endings.

archetypes.name: The Creator
archetypes.core_drive: Express meaning and reveal possibility through imagination, beauty, and original form.
archetypes.signature: Visionary, expressive, intuitive, aesthetically sensitive, and drawn to symbolic or transformative work.
archetypes.contribution: Gives shape to what others cannot yet articulate and renews culture through art, story, design, and imagination.
archetypes.shadow: Can romanticize chaos, resist structure, confuse expression with contribution, or abandon work before refinement.
archetypes.growth_edge: Develop discipline, critical testing, material stewardship, and consistent completion.

separation_rule.orientation_profile: Describes preferred modes of engaging with life; it is not mastery and carries no moral rank.
separation_rule.archetype_profile: A human-readable mixture label derived from orientation scores; it is a presentation and engagement lens, not a diagnosis.
separation_rule.lever_mastery: Evidence-based 0.0-1.0 estimates of trainable developmental capacities.
separation_rule.priority_context: Applicability, importance, readiness, urgency/risk, opportunity, and evidence confidence remain separate from mastery.

mastery_scale.0.0: Assessed with no demonstrated mastery; requires full guidance or cannot yet perform.
mastery_scale.0.4: Conceptual understanding or initial guided practice.
mastery_scale.0.6: Repeated practice with inconsistent real-world transfer.
mastery_scale.0.8: Reliable independent application in ordinary contexts.
mastery_scale.1.0: Integrated application under stress, adaptation across contexts, and ability to support or teach others.

competency_mastery.rule: Update from rubric-scored evidence. Completing a task logs practice or evidence but does not automatically increase mastery.

lever_mastery.formula: M_l = sum_q(a_q * w_ql * m_q) / sum_q(a_q * w_ql), over assessed competencies q

variables.a_q: 1 when the competency is applicable to the user, otherwise 0

lever_mastery.coverage_confidence: Track assessed weighted coverage and evidence quality/recency separately; do not interpret missing evidence as zero mastery.

development_need.formula: N_l = applicability_l * importance_l * readiness_l * urgency_l * confidence_l * (1 - M_l)^1.5
notes: Use null/unassessed routing before this formula.
The exponent emphasizes genuine low mastery without making moderate gaps disappear.
Opportunity/resource access may cap readiness rather than being moralized as a deficit.

task_priority.interpretation: Developmental need dominates. Personality style changes order by at most +/-5 percent and may instead be used only for framing or tie-breaking.

archetype_fit.orientation_scores: Six continuous 0.0-1.0 scores: discernment, agency, connection, stewardship, exploration, transcendence.
archetype_fit.formula: fit_archetype(i,j) = sqrt(orientation_i * orientation_j), normalized across all 15 archetypes for display.
archetype_fit.rule: Show a primary and secondary archetype or a mixture; never force exclusivity.

anti_gaming: Repeated low-effort completions cannot substitute for transfer under realistic conditions.
A task may generate evidence for multiple levers, but its lever weights must sum to 1.0.
Evidence quality, recency, context breadth, and observer independence are tracked separately from completion count.
Role-conditional competencies may be excluded without penalty.
No aggregate score is presented as human worth, virtue, or a definition of a perfect person.
